title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 10

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the weekly schedule lesson take place?
tasks.audioText: The production planning tutor will discuss a weekly schedule on Wednesday at eleven. Students should bring the sample order list and the capacity table. The class will identify planned start dates, expected completion dates and the departments involved. The tutor will also explain how to report a delay so that the schedule can be reviewed.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which table should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The production planning tutor will discuss a weekly schedule on Wednesday at eleven. Students should bring the sample order list and the capacity table. The class will identify planned start dates, expected completion dates and the departments involved. The tutor will also explain how to report a delay so that the schedule can be reviewed.

tasks.prompt: A production planner noticed that one component order was likely to be delayed because a required material had not arrived. The planner updated the schedule and informed the relevant departments. The message included the order reference, the expected delay and the next review date. This allowed the team to discuss alternatives without relying on an outdated schedule. Reading 1. Why was the component order likely to be delayed?
options: A required material had not arrived
The inspection report had not been printed
The supplier had changed the delivery address

tasks.prompt: What information did the planner include in the message?
options: The order reference, expected delay and next review date
The operator's name, shift and annual leave dates
The machine model, serial number and service date
The supplier's address, payment terms and invoice number

tasks.prompt: The updated schedule ___ to the relevant departments.
Choose TWO details that make a production delay report useful.
The amount of work or output that a department can handle is its ___.
You expect a delay in a component order. What should you tell the planning team?
options: I will wait until the deadline has passed.
The material has not arrived; the order reference and expected delay are included in my update.
The schedule is wrong, but I have no details.
I will change the dates without informing anyone.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of production planning communication in a logical order.
options: Inform the relevant departments and review the plan
Confirm the reason for the delay
correctOrder: Confirm the reason for the delay
Inform the relevant departments and review the plan

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how to communicate a production delay to a planning team. Include the order reference, reason and next action.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the message includes the order reference and factual reason for the delay (0–2); it states the next action or follow-up information needed by the planning team (0–2); the update is concise, professional and grammatically understandable (0–2); production/planning vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
